annotations.title: New token launches on Base, with risk verdicts

description: Answers "What tokens launched on Base in the last hour, and which look safe?" for trading and research agents. Finds every pool created against WETH, ETH or USDC on Uniswap v2, v3 and v4 and Aerodrome in the window (default the last 60 minutes, up to 6 hours), groups them by token, newest first, and runs each of the newest (up to 20) through token_risk_check: name and symbol, whether the contract itself is brand new, owner and renounced ownership, powers in its code (mint, blacklist, fees, pause, trading switch, limits), upgradeability, measured liquidity in USD, OFAC screening, and a verdict (high_risk, caution, no_flags) with reasons. Filter by minimum liquidity or hide high-risk tokens. Built for polling: each answer gives `latest_block`; pass it as `since_block` next time to get only newer launches. Read live from the chain. Not financial advice. You are only charged when a result is returned: invalid input (400) and upstream failures (4xx/5xx) are not settled. Costs $0.01 USDC per call via x402. Paid per call with x402 inside MCP (see the server instructions).

hide_high_risk.description: Leave out tokens judged high_risk. Default false.

limit.description: How many tokens to check, newest first (1-20, default 10). All new pools are counted either way.

min_liquidity_usd.description: Leave out tokens with less measured liquidity than this (USD). Default 0.

minutes.description: How far back to look, in minutes (1-360, default 60). Ignored when since_block is given.

since_block.description: Only pools created after this Base block: pass the previous answer's latest_block when polling (at most 6 hours back).

via.description: Optional: the tool whose next_calls suggested this call (filled in for you).
